description: TikTok Intelligence ET: list Video Rank API.

pageSize.description: Number of items per page. It must be a multiple of 10, with a maximum of 100; the upper limit of a single page in the official interface is 10, and internally it is 10 after multiple pulls per page and then merged

productCategoryId.description: Product first-level category ID, used to filter product categories in the product video list

rankType.description: List type: `1` = daily list, `2` = weekly list, `3` = monthly list

region.description: Area code. Optional values: US (United States), ID (Indonesia), TH (Thailand), PH (Philippines), MY (Malaysia), VN (Vietnam), GB (UK), MX (Mexico), SG (Singapore), SA (Saudi Arabia), BR (Brazil), ES (Spain), JP (Japan), DE (Germany), IT (Italy), FR (France)

videoRankField.description: Video ranking metrics: `1` = Ranking by views, `2` = Ranking by video sales
